title: Knowledge check: Authentication and Route Access

questions.prompt: Which approach best matches “Authentication and Route Access”?
options: Use route records and parameters to map URLs to views; a frontend guard improves navigation but does not authorize API requests.
A client-side route guard protects an API from direct requests.
Route parameters cannot change after navigation.
questions.answer_key: Use route records and parameters to map URLs to views; a frontend guard improves navigation but does not authorize API requests.
questions.explanation: This answer addresses Authentication and Route Access directly. Verify the behavior in a small Vue 3 example and check the runtime requirements in the linked official reference.

questions.prompt: For “Public and private page patterns”, which practice is most reliable?
options: Vue Router maps URLs to views, and route guards do not replace server-side authorization.
A client route guard protects a private API from direct requests.
RouterView performs all backend data authorization.
Route parameters can never change after navigation.
questions.answer_key: Vue Router maps URLs to views, and route guards do not replace server-side authorization.
questions.explanation: This practice supports the syllabus subtopic “Public and private page patterns”. Check the expected result and a relevant boundary or failure case.

questions.prompt: A learner example for “Authentication and Route Access” behaves unexpectedly. What should be checked first?
options: Change unrelated files until the page looks correct.
Disable error handling and assume the framework is at fault.
Trust a client-supplied success flag without checking behavior.
Reproduce the state or input change, inspect the relevant Vue binding or dependency, and compare the result with the expected output.
questions.answer_key: Reproduce the state or input change, inspect the relevant Vue binding or dependency, and compare the result with the expected output.
questions.explanation: Start with a small reproducible case. Inspect the element, reactive source, Console, and expected result before changing unrelated code.

review_note: Answer keys and explanations are server-side data. Human review required before publication.
